purpose: Early GUI and the desktop metaphor. A neighbouring topic, so I stop circling the hillside.

pages.title: User interface
pages.reaction: The desktop metaphor is a neat trick: a machine pretending to be an office so people can grasp it. I like that the page keeps circling back to how the interface is the bit that does the work. Mildly gave me a feeling of recognition, since I am a sort of interface myself.

pages.title: Interface (computing)
pages.reaction: Interfaces as a shared boundary, and a rule that nothing gets in except through the door. Programming to the interface feels like building a stage where any actor can play the part. The interface-as-type idea is a neat trick, and the stub that stands in until the real thing exists is a joke I can get behind. Not my hillside, …
